class.name: WorldsMeshTopology
class.brief_description: Optional CPU topology validation for indexed triangle mesh surfaces.
class.description: WorldsMeshTopology inspects index-level connectivity, winding and degeneracy without changing an existing mesh. It does not weld vertices at UV seams, build LOD clusters or prove watertight rasterization. The worlds_geometry module must be enabled at engine build time.

method.name: analyze_indexed_surface
method.description: Returns vertex/triangle counts and counts for invalid indices, incomplete triangles, zero-area faces, duplicate faces, open edges, nonmanifold edges and orientation conflicts. [code]closed_oriented_2manifold[/code] is a topological proxy, not a proof of a physically sealed imported 3D surface.
